apps.localizedDescription: NeoFreeBird, changed to look like the app before the rebrand.

versions.localizedDescription:
Version 7.3.31

Fixes
- Crash in the notifications code (unrecognized selector _tfs_arrayForKey:) that became frequent once push notifications worked

Version 7.3.30

Settings backup
- Now also carries D-day events, account aliases, highlight keywords, account bubble order and the custom accent colour
- Logins, tokens, drafts and history are still left out on purpose

Version 7.3.29

Debug
- Shake dump has a Chat section (chat socket frames, DM read requests, Chat tab badge changes) to track down the stuck DM badge

Version 7.3.28

From NeoFreeBird (up to Nov 6)
- Timeline filters no longer touch the notifications list
- Fixed square avatars on Liquid Glass, muted audio stopping other audio, padlock black screen, stale text, dim theme blur, legacy tab selector
- Autoplay follows settings
- Translators section, Brazilian Portuguese and updated translations
- iPad Split View option
- One-time welcome note after each update

Version 7.3.27

Account bubbles
- Profile pictures are kept on the device and only downloaded again when a profile picture changes

Fixed
- Timeline filters can no longer leave a list outside Home (such as notifications) completely empty

Debug
- Shake dump has a Timeline Filter section

Version 7.3.26

Fixed
- Crash when opening the account bubbles (long-press Home or the top-left avatar) in 7.3.25

Version 7.3.25

Account bubbles
- New Liquid Glass gear at the end of the arc: opens a list where you drag accounts into the order the circles use

Version 7.3.24

Account bubbles
- Circles open as one even arc (a quarter circle from a corner)
- Unread badges now read from X's own account list
- The account name shows above the arc, where the thumb does not cover it

Version 7.3.23

Account bubbles
- Profile pictures instead of initials
- Unread notification badge at the top right of each other account
- Circles no longer overlap with five or more accounts, even from a corner

Version 7.3.22

Fixed
- Account bubbles: long-pressing the top-left avatar now opens the circles instead of X's account list (iOS 26). Drag onto one and let go to switch, or let go first and tap one. A quick tap still opens X's list.

Debug
- Shake dump has an Account Bubbles section

Version 7.3.21

Fixed
- Account bubbles: long-press the top-left avatar now opens them, bubbles fan toward the screen center, tap to pick after release
- Return to last read: tapping the status bar now works, even when already at the top (10-second window)

Removed
- Jelly paw refresh, Conflict Cat and its huff animation, like heart particles, dark-mode header glow, post-sent logo burst, media parallax, and Kemo effect haptics

Version 7.3.20

New
- Account bubbles: long-press Home, drag to an avatar bubble to switch accounts (Liquid Glass on iOS 26)
- Settings backup/restore via clipboard code and QR
- Return to last read: tap the status bar again to jump back
- Jelly paw pull-to-refresh
- Conflict Cat shiver motion and result caching
- Haptics for Kemo effects

Version 7.3.19

Changed
- Removed the 6-level Mood Thermometer and all blur/hide overlays
- New: Conflict Cat badge, a small huffing angry cat under the avatar of divisive or bait tweets (off by default, animation toggle, respects Reduce Motion)

Version 7.3.18

New
- Mood Thermometer: on-device 6-level tone faces under avatars (calm to divisive), per-level visibility, sensitivity slider, and blur/hide for furious and divisive tweets (off by default)

Version 7.3.17

Fixes
- Fixed a crash when opening a tweet that has been quoted by others while a custom font is enabled

Version 7.3.16

Fixes
- Fixed like hearts, header glow, post-sent burst and media parallax not working at all on X 12.38.1
- Header glow is a bit more visible
- Like hearts now also work on photo double-tap
- Post-sent burst now triggers for replies and inline compose too

Version 7.3.15

New Effects
- Heart particles burst out when you like a post
- Soft glow on the header in dark mode
- Little burst animation when your post is sent
- Very subtle parallax on photos while scrolling (off in Low Power Mode and Reduce Motion)

All four can be toggled in settings.

Version 7.3.14

Fixes
- X and NSFW mode are a separate bar fixed to the bottom of the side menu. They do not scroll and they are not under D-day.

New Features
- Updated X to 12.38.1 (this now natively supports the iPhone Duo)
- Added experimental support for the Liquid Glass redesign. Most features have been adapted for it, but a couple aren’t possible to implement (see “Known Issues”)
- Hide the “Game” tab at the top of the timeline when a basketball game is ongoing
- Added an option to hide the “Videos for You” feed
- Added an option to reset settings
- Added an option to use a custom color for the tint
- Added a new split-view design for iPad which uses up the entire screen (instead of a stupid blown-up iPhone layout), allowing you to scroll the timeline in the left half and view an individual tweet or profile on the right half. This will not work on iPhone Duos since I do not have one to test this on, so right now it is hardcoded for iPads only.
- Now hides the Money tab on profiles
- Adds an option to hide the Quick Compose button (only on Liquid Glass)
- Added a new method for blocking screenshot detection

Fixes
- Made the app icon changer load differently to prevent the app hanging
- Fixed quote tweets not being filtered in the timeline
- Fixed downloading voice messages
- Fixed crashes and general slowdowns with web logins
- Fixed fast block not working
- Fixed the message button on tweets being clickable when hidden
- Fixed certain ads appearing on the timeline
- Fixed the custom font not appearing in a couple places

Known Issues
- The tweet source label option has been removed (again). X seems hellbent on burning all traces of Twitter (unlike us), so this feature will stay removed unless there’s another endpoint that can be used. Please ping @orionblur on Twitter if you think you’ve found such an endpoint, and we can take it to DMs.
- The “Keep the navigation bar visible” toggle doesn’t work on Liquid Glass, as quite a few app components rely on the tab bar being hidden at times, and in my testing trying to change this caused frequent crashes.
